purpose: Define the implementation-ready build contract for the first acceptable delta_uet_or_ci operator in the selected atomic predictive-v1 lane.

operator_target.required_model_form: E_or_nu_pred = standard_baseline(domain, constants, quantum_numbers) + delta_uet_or_ci(domain, locked_parameters, quantum_numbers)
operator_target.line_output_policy: Convert accepted level-energy outputs to wavelength/frequency only after level residual and uncertainty fields exist.

required_inputs: locked basis size or convergence policy
UET atomic Hamiltonian or transition operator derivation
constant-origin audit for h, alpha, masses, and charge coupling if claimed
locked UET parameters before holdout evaluation
declared mapping from UET variables to atomic quantum numbers
required_outputs: blocked_claims_when inherited standard constants remain inputs
acceptance_gates: claim_scope_gate_blocks first-principles wording until derivation and residuals align

forbidden_shortcuts: treat Bohr/Rydberg/Dirac baseline formulas as delta_uet_or_ci
treat empirical Lamb or quantum-defect fitted parameters as a fixed correction operator
fit correction parameters after viewing holdout or CHIANTI residuals
use same-source-family holdout residuals as independent validation
skip uncertainty outputs while upgrading diagnostic thresholds to validation thresholds
minimum_first_build_artifacts: operator parameter manifest with SHA256 recorded in primary artifact
operator residual table with source row IDs and no-leakage flag
operator uncertainty policy consumed by threshold gate
baseline comparator row comparing standard baseline, empirical diagnostic, and accepted operator
claim-scope update that keeps validation blocked until non-NIST external source rows exist
pass_conditions_for_accepting_operator: One implementation lane has current_status ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTED.
All required inputs and outputs for that lane are present in artifact rows.
Operator parameters are locked before holdout evaluation.
The fixed-correction operator gate records accepted_operator_count >= 1.
claim_boundary: This manifest makes the missing operator implementation actionable. It is not itself an implemented CI/correlated or UET atomic operator and cannot validate atomic spectra.
